model_output.rationale: 835 shows CO-16 on all three lines with MOA N286 at claim level. No referring/ordering provider appears in the 837P. Medicare Part B requires an ordering/referring NPI for therapy services. This is a data defect — correct and resubmit as new original (CLM05-3=1) since Part B does not accept frequency 7.

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed without an ordering/referring provider NPI. 835 returns CO-16 + N286 on all lines. The 837P contains no NM1*DN segment. Medicare Part B requires a valid referring provider for therapy CPTs.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring physician's NPI (verify in PECOS) to the 837P referring provider loop. Resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1). Do not use frequency 7 on Part B.

evidence.fact: All lines denied CO-16; claim-level MOA carries N286 (missing/invalid referring provider primary identifier)
No NM1*DN (ordering/referring provider) segment present in the claim
EB*1 active coverage for DOS 2026-02-25, Medicare Part B FFS — eligibility not at issue
